newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius shares buoyant, sentiment seen improving.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius shares buoyant, sentiment seen improving.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Mauritius market index, Semdex, rose for the 6th consecutive session on Friday, gaining 3.10 points to 326.34 as market sentiment was seen on the upbeat, brokers said.

Transaction volume was unofficially posted at 9.18 million rupees on 362,217 shares from 5.93 million rupees on 225,797 shares on Wednesday. In two weeks, the Semdex has climbed by 6.9 percent from its year low of 305.41 points on October 23, buoyed by gains in leading listed shares, brokers said.

"The outlook on the market is much, much better than it was a couple of weeks back and that is why we have seen such rise. But it must also be remembered that shares were grossly undervalued when the market was depressed," one broker said.
A majority of shares across the board were on the rise and commerce based stocks were particularly buoyant as the year end festivities were drawing close, bourse officials said.
Rogers gained 1.50 rupees to 88.50 on 5,037 shares and Happy World Foods was 50 cents higher to 15 rupees on 6,741 shares.
State Bank of Mauritius reached an all time high, up 10 cents to 8.70 rupees on 123,200 shares. Mauritius Commercial Bank was unchanged at 73 rupees on 33,346 shares.
Sugar-based Harel Freres dropped 50 cents to 41 rupees on a heavy 43,732 shares but Mon Tresor Mon Desert climbed 80 cents to 37 rupees on 10,800 shares.

Shares in the hotel sector continued to rise. Mauritius is in the middle of its peak tourism season. New Mauritius Hotels rose 50 cents to 29.50 rupees on 39,000 shares and Sun Resorts was up 20 cents to 35.70 rupees on 1,553 shares. National airline Air Mauritius gained 1.0 to 53 rupees on 5,070 shares.
